title: The Fourth, 2017
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: White fireworks. Lockboxes on the houses behind the dock. The crowd is half strangers. Gully pours for all of them the same.

panels.composition: The dock, fireworks white on blue. The crowd half strangers with phones up. GULLY pouring. MARIA in the chair. WOOD on the steps with BARNABY II.

image.prompt: a crowded dock at night under white fireworks, half the crowd strangers holding phones up, a man in an apron pouring, a woman in a lawn chair, a thin man on shack steps with a three-legged dog, clean ink with a blue wash

panels.composition: A phone screen, up, in the crowd: the fireworks, in color. Red.

image.prompt: close-up of a phone held up in a crowd showing fireworks in full red on its screen

panels.composition: Wood, looking at the phone, then the sky.

balloons.text: They're red in the sky, Woody.

image.prompt: a thin man on shack steps looking from a stranger's phone screen up to the sky

panels.composition: The finale. White, in the strip. Red, on forty phones. The chair. The steps. The pup barking at the sky.

image.prompt: a fireworks finale in white over a blue bay above a dock where dozens of raised phone screens show the same fireworks in red, a dog barking at the sky, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: White in the strip, red on the phones.
